s01-hook: One platform, every business process. Everything here is running.
s02-doctype: Declare a DocType in YAML. Forms, API, validation and indexes are all generated from the metadata.
s03-submit: One Submit, one transaction. A waybill is created, the customer care replica syncs, the ledger posts debit one three one, credit five one one.
s04-overlay: Each tenant has its own configuration. Hanoi adds VAT and a tax code; the app code stays the same.
s05-wasm: The tenant's pricing formula runs in a Wasm sandbox. An infinite loop is stopped after fifty milliseconds.
s06-mcp: The AI agent works with the user's own permissions. Names, phone numbers and addresses are masked before they reach the model.
s07-cdc: Write in operations, read right away in customer care. No stale data, thanks to a CDC worker written in Rust.
s08-seata: Seata keeps three resources consistent. When an order goes over the credit limit, everything is rolled back.
s09-outro: Astra. One platform, every business process. Open source, MIT license.
